newMethod: Schakel low-carbohydrate default 50; primary author slide 12 and publisher results snippet checked. No new measured product GI.
pepperExtension: Only this weighed tiny portion; separate explicit project interpretation. 38.6 g CHO/100 g is not low-carbohydrate.
rejected: Nasu 2005 tested 0.5 g spice with rice and 10 g butter, against rice-based reference, not isolated Dijon or black pepper GI. No glucose-scale GI borrowed.
Khan 2024 black pepper meal intervention measures a 50 g carbohydrate mixed breakfast, not isolated pepper GI; no credit for glucose-lowering effects.
Louie 2015 low-carbohydrate zero assignment is not adopted: positive CHO stays in calculation.
AFCD F008227 shallot description is immature onion with green stalks (scallion), not Finnish bulb shallot. It is rejected.
Fineli 335 is yellow onion. The proposed recipe explicitly changes to 55 g yellow onion; original shallot recipe does not receive this number.
Generic mustard, wholegrain mustard and different-market Maille fibre declarations are not merged with Finnish smooth 1 kg product.
No assignment of GI 0 to stock, spices or mustard; no use of GI 100 as upper bound.
limits: All positive-CHO ingredients use a source comparator or an explicit imputation, so confidence is LOW.
Assigned GI uncertainty is unbounded; diagnostics are not an interval.
Generically sourced raw ingredient composition and all-consumed preparation are proposed input definitions, not chemical analysis of the cooked meal.
